title: Added a comprehensive reliability eval matrix
points: Added 24 durable cases covering entity grounding, follow-up scope, periods and coverage, deterministic computes, runtime collisions, narrative evidence, data quality, and correct insufficiency.
Eval reports now distinguish unexpected failures from documented known failures and flag known defects that appear resolved for repeat verification.

The first test-Worker run isolated ambiguous missing scope, uppercase-prose ticker noise, compute ownership collisions, missing model-input QC propagation, and a failed bear-market selector handoff as the next reliability priorities.
